text: Core atomics shall support widths 1..65535 at actual live ordinary integer locations with ordinary alignment. Finite byte-vector sequences may implement indivisibility solely for the advertised single-agent domain. They shall not imply interrupt/multiprocessor safety.

obligations.text: Core atomics shall support widths 1..65535 at actual live ordinary integer locations with ordinary alignment.
